test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who was the author of Tarikh-i-Mubarak Shahi which is a Persian language chronicle of the Delhi Sultanate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yahya bin Ahmad Sirhindi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tarik-i-Mubarak Shahi is written by Yahya-bin-Ahmad Sirhindi.
 
• Tarikh-i Mubarak Shahi provides valuable information about the rulers of Sayyid Dynasty (1414-1451 AD) of Delhi.
 
• It also contains the history of Muhammad Ghori and his rulers up to the third ruler of the Sayyid dynasty.
 
• The earlier part of the book was written with the help of the works of other historians but the later part was written by him on the basis of trustworthy information and personal knowledge.
 
• 
 
Many later writers have used it as a primary text for their works.
